requirement.description: The model registry is broken and cannot accept new model versions. The registry exists but is currently non functional.
requirement.fact: The model registry is broken and cannot accept new model versions.
requirement.reading: The registry exists but is currently non functional.

narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I noticed the model registry interface is currently non functional during my latest deployment attempt. It used to handle versioning smoothly, but right now it rejects any new model upload. The team has stopped trying to push updates through the standard pipeline. Instead, we are manually copying model artifacts to a shared network drive and updating a local spreadsheet to track which version is live. This workaround keeps the retraining cycle moving, but it means the central registry remains empty of recent changes while I document the current state by hand.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively reports the current non-functional state of the registry and the team's resulting manual workaround without expressing a wish, refusal, or explicit trade-off.
